## What are the next steps?

If you have been assigned as a reviewer to this Merge Request,
please review this Merge Request with the same scrutiny as any community contribution:

1.  Ensure that the dependencies updated meet our standards:
    - _Security_: Dependencies do not contain malicious code
    - _Performance_: Dependencies do not bloat the application code or prolong CI times unnecessarily
    - _Stability_: Pipelines are passing

2.  Review the changes introduced by the version upgrade. Consider using https://my.diffend.io to compare the two versions in case the updated dependency is either a Ruby Gem or a Node.js package, for example to [compare `pg_query` `2.1.0` and `2.1.4`](https://my.diffend.io/gems/pg_query/2.1.0/2.1.4).

3.  Review the upstream changelog or release notes for behavior changes, such as changed status codes, changed defaults, and deprecations. Do this even on patch bumps.
    - If a change qualifies as a [breaking change](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/api_styleguide/#what-is-a-breaking-change), mark this MR as draft and complete the [breaking-change approval process](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/deprecation_guidelines/#how-do-i-get-approval-to-move-forward-with-a-breaking-change) before merging.
    - Once approved, or for behavior changes that are [not breaking changes](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/api_styleguide/#what-is-not-a-breaking-change), add a `Changelog: changed` trailer to the commit, consider notifying support, and have a rollback plan before merging.

4.  Check if `bundle install` works locally, in the context of GDK.

5.  If tests are passing and you've reviewed the updated dependencies, execute pipelines in the [context of the main project][main_context]

    This MR is created from a fork, therefore not _all_ jobs (e.g. Danger) might have been executed.
    Instead of hitting MWPS right away, you might want to wait until the pipeline you've just triggered finished.

    _Note_: This might not be available in projects, in that case merging right away is an option

6.  Assign the current milestone to the MR

7.  Merge away!
